prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Your Companion", "Your pet is ready on your desktop! Next, quickly test voice interaction to start talking with your companion.", "Practice Voice Commands"]
1: ["Master Desktop Companion Controls", "Learn the instant shortcut to show or hide your pet anytime while working.", "Start Gesture Practice"]
2: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "Your custom pet is acquiring unique desktop traits and habits right now.", "Previewing Personality: Curious, Playful, and Responsive"]
3: ["Choose Your Companion Experience", "Select how you would like your pet to companion you on your desktop today.", "Story & Companion Modes"]
4: ["Desktop Docking Configured", "Your companion is anchored and ready to interact on your desktop."]
5: ["Generating Companion Assets", "Hatching pet animations and desktop interaction models..."]
6: ["Customize Your Pet Starter Kit", "Pick your companion's favorite starting toy and snack before finalization.", "Included: Cozy Bed & Favorite Snack"]
7: ["Sign In & Protect Your Companion", "Logging in ensures your pet memory, traits, and custom items remain safe across installs.", "Automatic Cloud Pet Data Backup"]
8: ["How Would You Like Your Pet to Interact?", "Select Desktop Companion for an ongoing screen buddy, or Story Mode for an interactive guided adventure.", "Continue with Selection"]
9: ["Quick System Tray Access", "Take a 5-second tour of your system tray companion control menu.", "Try Tray Menu"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or included promotional items
